name: Prowler Slack
discord_description: Community for the Prowler open-source cloud security assessment tool (AWS/Azure/GCP/K8s security scanning).
candidate_notes: goto.prowler.com/slack is Prowler's own durable redirect.

name: Atomic Red Team Slack
discord_description: Community for Atomic Red Team (Red Canary), focused on adversary emulation, detection testing, and MITRE ATT&CK-mapped test scripts.
candidate_notes: Durable project-owned redirect; documented in the project README.

name: Volatility Slack
discord_description: Community for the Volatility memory-forensics framework, for support and discussion among DFIR practitioners.
candidate_notes: Durable redirect published by the Volatility Foundation itself.

name: Checkov Slack (Codified Security)
discord_description: Community for the Checkov infrastructure-as-code static analysis tool, for policy-writing and scanning support.
candidate_notes: Listed on the Checkov project README and homepage footer; exact self-service invite step could not be independently confirmed beyond the workspace link itself, so treat as listed rather than fully verified.

name: GNU Radio Matrix Chat
discord_description: Matrix chatroom for the GNU Radio SDR (software-defined radio) project, used for community help and development discussion.
candidate_notes: Redirect page (chat.gnuradio.org) that hands you into the Matrix room; linked directly from the project README.

name: Tor Project #tor (Matrix)
discord_description: Official Tor Project user-support and community room, bridged to the OFTC IRC channel of the same name.
candidate_notes: Also reachable as IRC #tor on irc.oftc.net (bridged); #tor-space:matrix.org is a Matrix Space aggregating other Tor rooms.
